ctaText: Contact McKee Security today. We will assess your needs, recommend the right Yealink hardware, and provide a clear quote with no surprises. Call us at (705) 457-2156 or use the inquiry form below.
html:
Professional VoIP Phone Service

HOSTED & MANAGED BY MCKEE SECURITY

Most of the phone systems we install are for businesses, from a single desk phone at a front counter to a multi-extension office, and we look after homes on the same platform with the same people. Either way you get fully hosted VoIP with local support you can actually reach. We handle setup, configuration, provisioning, and number porting. You never have to deal with a call centre or troubleshoot on your own.

Hosted VoIP, Local Support

Every system is installed and tested by our team before it ever rings for the first time. Our technicians provision the hardware, test call quality, verify E911 registration, and walk you through the system before the job is complete. When something needs attention, you reach us directly, not a help desk somewhere across the country.

Business Phone Systems Built for How You Work

For commercial clients, we design and deploy VoIP systems that handle the real demands of a business environment. That includes multiple numbers, call routing, auto-attendant, voicemail-to-email, hold music, and more. All systems are hosted on our managed platform, provisioned by our team, and supported locally. We handle full number porting from your existing provider with zero downtime, and we only cut over once the new system has been tested end to end.

Because the system is not built around physical lines, the ceiling on how many calls you can take at once disappears completely. Every number can be busy and every phone can be on a call at the same time. Your numbers ring every phone in the building, messages collect in one voicemail box rather than one per line, and outbound calls show your main number.

Auto-Attendant Voicemail to Email No Limit on Simultaneous Calls Multiple Numbers & DID Call Transfer & Hold Zero-Downtime Porting

Cordless Coverage Past the Front Desk

Plenty of work does not happen at a desk. On a shop floor, in a service bay, out in a yard or down at the far end of a warehouse, a phone that only rings at the front counter is a phone that gets missed. Yealink DECT cordless handsets register to the same system as your desk phones, so a call to your main number rings the office and the back of the building together and whoever reaches it first picks up.

Handsets can be added to a system that already has desk phones, and rugged models are available where the environment is hard on equipment, such as a garage bay or an outdoor work area.

Rings With Your Desk Phones Shop, Bay & Yard Coverage Rugged Handset Options One Number, One Voicemail Expands As You Grow

Commercial Yealink Professional Desk Phones

We offer Yealink desk phones across four tiers to suit any business environment, from a busy front counter to a multi-extension office. Every tier carries the same HD voice and background noise suppression, so the choice comes down to screen size, key count and how the handset works, never to call quality. All models support PoE and are provisioned and tested by our team before they arrive.

Yealink T73 Entry Level Phone

A straightforward business phone with nothing extra to learn. Colour display, a comfortable handset, and a row of keys you can set as one-touch dials for the people you call most.

Yealink T74 Mid Tier Phone

The same phone with a noticeably larger and sharper display and more room for one-touch dials. Easy to read a caller's name at a glance from across the desk.

Yealink T85W Premium Phone

The one we recommend, and the phone most of our business systems are built on. A large 5.5-inch display on a stand that tilts to your eye level, backlit keys that stay easy to find in a dim room, and Bluetooth built in for a wireless headset.

Yealink T88W Pro Executive Phone

The only phone in the range with a genuinely cordless handset, with roughly thirty feet of range, so you can answer at the desk and keep talking as you walk. Large Android touchscreen you tap rather than work through buttons.

The Same System, at Home

Fewer households keep a landline every year, and the ones that do usually keep it because replacing it sounded like a project. It is not. Residential VoIP runs on the same hosted platform as our business systems, gets installed the same way, and is supported by the same people you would reach for anything else we look after.

Reliable Home Phone Service, Without the Landline

Our residential VoIP service gives you everything you would expect from a traditional home phone. You get crystal-clear HD voice quality, voicemail, caller ID, call waiting, and unlimited local and long distance calling across Canada and North America. Everything is delivered over your existing internet connection. We install and configure the equipment, transfer your existing number if you would like to keep it, and remain your direct point of contact for ongoing support.

Unlimited NA Calling Voicemail & Caller ID Call Forwarding E911 Compliance Managed Number Porting Local McKee Support

Residential Yealink DECT Cordless Systems

We deploy Yealink DECT cordless phone systems for all residential installations. These are purpose-built VoIP handsets with HD audio, long range, and a clean modern design that fits naturally in any home. Multiple handsets register to a single W70B base station so any phone in the house can answer the same line.

Yealink W70B Base Yealink DECT Handsets HD Audio Long Range DECT Multi-Handset Support

Why McKee Security VoIP

Locally managed. Professionally installed. Personally supported.

We Configure Every Account

When you sign up for VoIP through McKee Security, you are not signing up for a self-serve platform. We configure every account, install every phone, and stay your direct point of contact for the life of your service.

Tested Before It Rings

Our technicians provision hardware, test call quality, verify E911 registration, and walk you through the system before the job is complete. Our hosted platform is managed on the back end by our carrier partner.

30+ Years in Haliburton

We have been supporting residential and commercial clients across the Haliburton region for over 30 years. VoIP is a natural extension of that relationship. It is one more way we keep your home or business connected.

Pricing on Inquiry

Every installation varies depending on the number of phones, hardware selected, number porting requirements, and system complexity. Contact us for a no-obligation quote tailored to your business or home.

Commercial VoIP

From a single desk phone to a multi-extension office with auto-attendant and voicemail-to-email, with cordless handsets wherever the work happens away from a desk. We build the system around how you actually work.

Residential VoIP

Replace your landline with a Yealink DECT system installed and supported by our local team. Keep your number, get unlimited calling, and call us when you need help.
